- In `apps/app/src/services/sightings/actions/sightings-time-chunk.ts`, both search calls that previously used:
  - `{ latitude: { $ne: null } }` and `{ longitude: { $ne: null } }`
- Now use valid Xata syntax:
  - `{ latitude: { $exists: true } }` and `{ longitude: { $exists: true } }`
- Kept the date range filter unchanged: `{ date: { $ge: startDate, $le: endDate } }`.

Why:
- Xata search filters don’t support `$ne` with `null`. `$exists: true` is the correct way to ensure a column is present/non-null.
